pool.text: Russian leaders founded Yekaterinburg alongside a massive iron-making plant.
Catherine the Great granted Yekaterinburg the status of a district town.
Yekaterinburg was assigned the status of the only mountain city.
The Kaslinsky cast iron pavilion won main awards at the Paris event.
Laurage became established as the very first cinema in the city.
Yekaterinburg established its first university under a decree.
A tram network was completed during the Soviet era in Sverdlovsk.
The tram network was established to play a leading role.
Hermitage Museum collections were evacuated from Leningrad to Sverdlovsk.
The Sverdlovsk Film Studio officially opened in the city.
A television studio was built, broadcasting its first telecast.
Coloured television officially appeared in the city.
Ipatiev House was demolished by order of Boris Yeltsin.
An anthrax outbreak occurred in Sverdlovsk attributed to a military facility.
Construction of a new television tower began in the city.
The city began operating the sixth metro in Russia.
Vladimir Putin and Gerhard Schroder negotiated in the city.
The asteroid 27736 Ekaterinburg was named in the city's honour.
Foreign ministers of the BRIC countries met in Yekaterinburg.
Yekaterinburg hosted the Global Summit on Manufacturing and Industrialization.
